tasks.description: Extract atomic notes from VQ-VAE bioacoustics state-of-art synthesis (Feb 2026)
notes: Update [[no published work has applied VQ-VAE to animal vocalizations making this a genuine research gap]] with 2025 evidence from Sarkar NeurIPS workshop
New note: post-hoc VQ on frozen HuBERT embeddings underperforms end-to-end training (Sarkar NeurIPS 2025)
New note: Best 2023 convolutional AE shows learned representations beat handcrafted features for repertoire clustering
New note: AVES (Hagiwara ICASSP 2023) as potential backbone architecture
New note: FSQ (Mentzer ICLR 2024) as alternative to VQ-VAE that eliminates codebook collapse
New note: STSG discrete token approach (K-means 16k tokens) significantly underperforms transfer learning baselines
New note: speech SSL models transfer to bioacoustics with only marginal gain from domain-specific pretraining
Synthesis note: gap analysis table — what combinations of discrete/end-to-end/learned codebook exist in literature
